info.title: ignixa-fakes
info.description: CLI tool for generating FHIR test data using the FhirFakes library. Supports single resources, scenarios, and population generation.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: FHIR Fakes - Generate and model FHIR test data

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: help
commands.description: Display detailed help for commands and available options

arguments.name: TOPIC
arguments.description: Topic to get help on (e.g., 'scenarios', 'states', 'cities')

options.name: --out
options.description: Output folder for generated files

options.name: --firstname
options.description: Patient first name

options.name: --surname
options.description: Patient surname

options.name: --from
options.description: City to generate from

options.name: --validate
options.description: Validate generated resource against schema [default: False]

options.name: --edge-cases
options.description: Enable edge-case perturbation. Optionally specify comma-separated selectors (families or categories).

options.name: --seed
options.description: Seed for reproducible edge-case generation

options.name: --include-invalid
options.description: Include non-validity-preserving (MayViolate/AlwaysInvalid) strategies when edge-cases are enabled [default: False]

options.name: --density
options.description: Generation density: minimal|realistic|maximum (default minimal). realistic/maximum use the schema generator for ANY resource type and therefore IGNORE --firstname/--surname/--from and the Observation stateName specialization. realistic currently behaves identically to minimal.

options.name: --theme
options.description: Clinical theme for coherent code selection with --density maximum (e.g. cardiology, endocrinology, orthopedic-surgery). Omit for a random theme per resource; use 'none' to disable theming.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print full exception details (type and stack trace) on error [default: False]

arguments.name: RESOURCETYPE
arguments.description: The FHIR resource type (e.g., Patient, Observation)

arguments.name: STATENAME
arguments.description: Optional state/builder name (e.g., BloodGlucose for Observation)

options.name: --out
options.description: Output folder for generated files

options.name: --resolved-references
options.description: Create a batch bundle instead of references [default: False]

options.name: --validate
options.description: Validate generated resources against schema [default: False]

options.name: --param
options.description: Override a scenario parameter, format name=value (repeatable, e.g. --param age=60 --param severity=3) [default: System.String[]]

arguments.name: SCENARIONAME
arguments.description: The scenario name (e.g., DiabeticPatient)

options.name: --out
options.description: Output folder for generated files

options.name: --from
options.description: City or state to generate from

options.name: --count
options.description: Number of patients to generate [default: 10]

options.description: Create batch bundles instead of references [default: False]

options.name: --ndjson
options.description: Write ndjson files instead of bundles (implies --resolved-references) [default: False]
